title: MeshView
description: One version of a mesh of the setup, as the window draws it.

archive.description: The archive the version is in, or `None` for a loose file.

path.description: The mesh, below the data directory.

tint.description:
For a face, the face texture that colours the head, as a PNG
`data:` address.

MeshShape.description:
One surface of a mesh. Numbers are little-endian and Base64-encoded,
which keeps a face of a few thousand points small.

alphaTest.description:
Whether the transparent parts of the texture are left out, as
between strands of hair.

indices.description: The triangles: three 32-bit point numbers each.

texture.description: The colour texture as a PNG `data:` address, if it could be read.

tinted.description: Whether the face texture colours this surface: the head itself.

uvs.description: The texture coordinates: two 32-bit floats per point, or empty.
